title: Vision, audio and multimodal
summary: Core (15A): the multimodal skills AI Engineers and FDEs deploy — transfer learning, VLM structured extraction, document AI and multimodal RAG, ASR/TTS, realtime voice agents and slice-based evaluation. Branch (15B, deep): CNNs/ResNet, detection/segmentation, ViT/CLIP, diffusion and flow matching (CS231n 2025 + MIT 6.S184).

capstone.title: Multimodal assistant (A) or trained vision/generative model (B)
capstone.brief: A (AI Eng/FDE): a multimodal document or voice assistant for a real Pakistani workflow (e.g. Urdu/English utility-bill extraction, or a clinic phone-triage demo) with slice evals and a cost/latency table (scaffold ideas: rohitg00 phase 19 lessons 03 realtime voice assistant, 04 multimodal document QA, 12 video understanding pipeline). B (deep branch): a trained detector or a small diffusion/flow model with ablations.

levels: 3: licensed/consented data, split by source, documented slices
3: baseline + justified improvement proven by ablation
3: modality-correct metrics per slice + failure gallery
2: p95 latency and cost per page/minute/image
3: p95, cost, hardware notes and a fallback path
3: README, demo, limitations incl. bias and consent
